newsitem.title: POLAND: JUTRZENKA PLANS NEW SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: JUTRZENKA PLANS NEW SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Polish confectioner Jutrzenka SA plans a new share issue, ex-rights, it said in a statement on Monday.
It said the management's proposal had still to be approved by an extraordinary general shareholders meeting on December 7.
Company officials declined to give details of the issue.
Earlier this month the firm, based in Bydgoszcz, northern Poland, said it was seeking a strategic or financial investor to take a minority stake.

Jutrzenka, which netted 7.1 million zlotys last year and 5.9 million through the first eight months of 1996, seeks to transfer next year to the Warsaw bourse's main market from the parallel floor. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
